detail: 3,000 random-vs-random games (94,632 turns), 2,000 easy-bot-vs-random games (34,952 turns), and two targeted scenarios (repetition draw, 200-turn cap). At every turn the clean-room simulator parsed the exact prompt text, predicted the next position from the rulebook alone, and matched the engine on switches, sparks, scores, legal moves and repetition counts.
